brand.name: JanSahayak

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in to check schemes you may be eligible for and track your saved information.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Register once to get personalised scheme guidance in your language.
signup.acceptTerms: I accept the terms of use and privacy policy.
signup.verifyEmail: Account created. Please check your email to verify your account before logging in.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email linked to your account. If it exists, we will send a reset link.
forgot.success: If an account exists for that email, a reset link has been sent.

dashboard.title: Your dashboard
dashboard.intro: This is a temporary home page for the authentication module. Scheme recommendations will appear here in the full JanSahayak application.
